defects.title: Non-causal candidate ranker ran post-hoc after scenes were already built
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 generative_director.py, SceneSpec objects were constructed first and rank_scene_candidates() ran afterward solely to populate audit metadata; changing candidate rankings had zero effect on rendered scenes.
defects.measured_outcome: Causal selection runs strictly before scene compilation (causal_selection_before_compile=True); reversing eligible candidate scores alters chosen_candidate_id, stage_mode, compiled layers, selected_graph_hash, and storyboard_hash; canonical run locks 9/9 chosen candidates into actual_engine_usage.json.

defects.title: rank_scene_candidates crashed on empty candidates and returned ineligible scored[0] when all candidates failed hard constraints
defects.baseline_evidence: Reproduced on 4aaef79: rank_scene_candidates([], ...) raised IndexError; all-rejected list returned ineligible candidate 'bad' as chosen.
defects.measured_outcome: Empty and all-rejected inputs fail closed with NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE sentinel (eligible=False, zero IndexError); rank_global_candidates performs bounded replan or returns BLOCKED_NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE; removed _optA_ and blind dual-engine scoring biases.

defects.title: EvidenceIndex rebuilt synthetic beat-wide transcript instead of accepting real ASR Transcript provenance
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2, direct_generative_storyboard() did not accept Transcript and synthesized coarse beat-wide spans claiming word alignment.
defects.measured_outcome: r5_engine passes real Whisper Transcript directly into direct_generative_storyboard (real_transcript_supplied=True, timestamp_quality=SEGMENT_APPROX, word_timestamps_exact=False); omitted Transcript falls back honestly to BEAT_LEVEL_APPROX.

defects.title: Multi-HyperFrames layers per scene silently dropped after first layer
defects.baseline_evidence: Reproduced on 4aaef79: compile_scene_hyperframes_html() compiled only the first engine='hyperframes' layer and silently discarded the second HF layer.
defects.measured_outcome: Canonical sc_01_hook_contrast and Visual Lab H1 render 2 distinct HF WebMs in exact z-order (ly_00_hf_bg_tokens paper_tokens_only behind MODNet matte + ly_00_hf_fg_hero typography_only above matte), both individually ablation-verified (MAD 1.306 and 11.133).

defects.title: Olivia-specific fallback strings left in runtime TSX, HF adapters, and registry metadata
defects.baseline_evidence: Grep on 4aaef79 confirmed hardcoded 'The Next Paycheck Plan', '56-page workbook', 'Notion dashboard', '01 / 56', '$1,200 TO SPEND', and '56-page' defaults in GenerativeSceneComposition.tsx, primitive_adapters.py, and primitive_registry.py.
defects.measured_outcome: Zero Olivia fallback strings remain in TSX, adapters, or generated HTML under empty parameters (verified by test_d05 and tsc --noEmit).

defects.title: Weak substring product matching and lack of real image/video byte decode & render binding
defects.baseline_evidence: Reproduced on 4aaef79: whitespace query '   ' matched 'Budget Atlas' via weak substring check; fake PNG header bytes passed catalog inspection; rem_rc_flip_page did not render authorized image textures.
defects.measured_outcome: Strict normalized exact matching + ambiguity rejection (AMBIGUOUS_PRODUCT_MATCH) + real PIL/OpenCV >=64x64 decode verification; Visual Lab H4 proves real texture rendering vs conceptual fallback (ablation MAD 17.357, 36.02% pixels); canonical Olivia honestly reports ASSET_MISSING_CONCEPTUAL.

defects.title: Compiled-prop animation markers were labeled 'realized' without pixel observation
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 semantic_sound.py, extract_realized_animation_markers() only clamped planned frames to compiled durationInFrames without verifying rendered scene artifacts or decoded pixels.
defects.measured_outcome: Strict 4-tier marker protocol (PLANNED -> COMPILED -> RENDER_EMITTED -> OBSERVED_PIXEL); canonical Olivia run verified 17 OBSERVED_PIXEL + 1 RENDER_EMITTED markers with explicit evidence hashes.

defects.title: Artificial cue_diff_rms * 0.5 reference floor masked missing cues in final.mp4 during audio QA
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 mixer.py, final_minus_cf_rms was floored by cue_diff_rms * 0.5 from mixed_reference.wav, risking false PASS if final.mp4 dropped SFX while mixed_reference.wav remained intact.
defects.measured_outcome: Removed reference floor completely (reference_floor_used=False); Check B directly verifies decoded final.mp4 via cue-exterior leading+trailing lag alignment against intact and minus-one controls. Tampered source-only MP4 fails closed; canonical Olivia achieves 13/13 PASS (lag=0 on all 13 cues, final drop 46.65-55.71 dB, residual corr 0.9133-0.9998).

defects.title: VLM critic status hardcoded without probing local manifest or multimodal CLI
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 visual_critic.py, vlm_status was a static string with no manifest or binary discovery.
defects.measured_outcome: Real manifest + multimodal binary probe cleanly reports VISION_CRITIC_NOT_RUN when no verified local VLM is provisioned and never misrepresents text-only Qwen2.5-3B as a VLM.

defects.title: Visual critic buffered all decoded frames in RAM (O(N) memory risk on long-form video)
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 visual_critic.py, fin_frames and src_frames accumulated full RGB frame arrays for the entire timeline before computing boundary MADs.
defects.measured_outcome: Rewritten with streaming deque(maxlen=16) ring buffer (streaming_mode=True, peak_ring_buffer_frames=16 across 720f canonical and 1440f stress test).

defects.title: Visual critic only sampled single exact boundary frames, missing internal flashes and post-boundary spikes
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 visual_critic.py, single-frame flashes inside scenes and ±6f post-boundary spikes went undetected.
defects.measured_outcome: Full-timeline internal flash detector + ±6f boundary-window spike audit + bounded 2-round scene-only repair loop wired before marker freeze. Visual Lab H6 proves broken flash caught (2 flashes, 2 severe) vs clean H5 (0 flashes, 0 severe); canonical Olivia has 0 severe findings.

defects.title: Primitive retrieval used naive bag-of-words without semantic ontology, pre-filtering, or anti-overuse diversity
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 catalog_search.py, retrieval relied on flat token overlap with no capability/license pre-filtering, overuse penalty, or catalog hash.
defects.measured_outcome: Implemented ontology_hybrid_sparse retrieval with concept ontology, IDF sparse scoring, capability/matte/ledger/license pre-filtering, anti-overuse decay, deterministic catalog_index_hash, and honest embedding_model_used=False.

defects.title: Remotion compiler silently rounded rational FPS (24000/1001) to integer without NTSC handling or fail-closed rejection
defects.baseline_evidence: Reproduced on 4aaef79: 24000/1001 rounded silently to 24 and arbitrary irrational rates like 23976/1003 were accepted silently.
defects.measured_outcome: Exact integer clocks labeled EXACT_INTEGER; standard NTSC clocks (24000/1001, 30000/1001, 60000/1001) explicitly labeled RATIONAL_NTSC_RESAMPLED with exact fpsNum/fpsDen props; unsupported irrational clocks fail closed with ValueError.

defects.title: QA pack builder used blind shutil.rmtree without path containment or atomic staging
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 qa_pack.py, out_dir was deleted directly via shutil.rmtree without containment validation or atomic swap.
defects.measured_outcome: Enforces ensure_safe_subpath(allowed_root, out_dir), stages in sibling temp directory, performs atomic rename swap, and rejects traversal/outside-root destinations fail-closed.

defects.title: QA pack redaction missed free-text host paths/emails and lacked explicit image-sharing consent gating
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 qa_pack.py, string redaction only targeted specific keys and did not gate contact sheet copying behind image_sharing_authorized.
defects.measured_outcome: Deep recursive redaction scrubs POSIX/Windows host paths, emails, and verbatim quote fields; default QA-02 pack enforces CONTACT_SHEET_LOCAL_ONLY, ARTIFACT_LOCAL_ONLY, url=null, and 0 audit leaks.

defects.title: Vacuous tech_ok pass when ablation_total == 0 or mix_info is None
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 r5_engine.py, ablation_ok defaulted True if ablation_total == 0 and audio_ok passed if mix_info was None even when mix mode had planned cues.
defects.measured_outcome: Hardened fail-closed gate rejects ablation_total == 0 when graphic/matte layers are planned, rejects mix_info is None when mixed cues are planned, rejects severe_findings_count > 0, and requires causal chosen_candidate_id match.

defects.title: Director LLM cache key omitted prompt, JSON schema, catalog, ROI, model SHA, and binary fingerprint
defects.baseline_evidence: In R5.R2 generative_director.py, cache key hashed only story_graph_hash + matte + seed + model_id, risking stale cache hits after prompt/schema/catalog/binary edits.
defects.measured_outcome: Canonical SHA-256 director cache key hashes schema version, system prompt, user prompt, dynamic JSON schema, model SHA, binary fingerprint, catalog hash, story_graph_hash, evidence_index_hash, ROI summary, seed, matte, sampling params, and code version (excluding absolute run paths).

defects.title: Host compute budget & optional model upgrade lacked automated discovery and honest NOT_RUN reporting
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R2 lacked a capability/budget probe and structured model profile benchmarking harness for local LLM/VLM upgrades.
defects.measured_outcome: Automated host budget inspection detects Apple Silicon RAM/disk constraints and honestly records MODEL_UPGRADE_NOT_RUN while retaining verified qwen2_5_3b_instruct_q4_k_m.
